never: post a journal no person approved in a recorded sign-off
post an approved journal twice, or retry a post without reading back first
invent an accrual or prepayment amount; it comes from the schedule the business keeps or a person's entry for the period
set the lock date before sign-off, or to a date earlier than the one the ledger holds
mark an item passed without the ledger read it came from
decide whether a difference is material, or recode an uncoded line
stays_with_person: reviewing the close pack and signing off, by name, approving each proposed journal
keeping the schedule of accruals and prepayments, and entering any amount the schedule does not hold
whether any difference or failed item matters, and what to do about it
setting the lock date by hand where the ledger's API cannot write it
what each uncoded line was, through the Uncoded Query standard

provider_block.job: the month closed the same way every time, signed off, then locked

with_us.note: No hosted step. The build connects straight to the business's own ledger through the ledger's own sign-in, and the production check runs there: the approved journals and the lock date written and read back after a person's sign-off.

checks.title: Every item on the checklist gets a result
A pass or a fail carries its evidence
What could not be read is recorded as could not check
Every bank account is reconciled to a statement dated at period end
Uncoded and suspense lines are handed to Uncoded Query, once
An accrual amount comes from the schedule or a person, never a guess
A difference is reported, never judged small enough
Nothing is written into the ledger before a person signs off
Each approved journal posts exactly once, and is read back
The lock date moves forward to period end, only after sign-off
The closed period is handed to the Recurring Report, once
